 // For example, if covergroup name is g1 and coverpoint is cp1, the TableTag to go to the Group's CoverPoint Table summary is g1_cp1 
 // For example, if covergroup name is g1, instance name is i1, coverpoint is cp1, the TableTag to go to the Instance's CoverPoint Table summary is g1_i1_cp1
